verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Saviour I come
Quiet my soul remember
Redemption's hill
Where Your blood was spilled
For my ransom

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
Everything I once held dear
I count it all as loss

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Lead me to the cross
Where Your love poured out
Bring me to my knees
Lord I lay me down

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Rid me of myself
I belong to You
Lead me
Lead me to the cross

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
You were as I
Tempted and trialed
Human

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
The word became flesh
Bore my sin and death
Now you're risen

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
To your heart
To your heart
Lead me to your heart
Lead me to your heart
